one_month_reasoning: Correction from round 1: CEG did not fall on 9/29; it rose 1.6% (260.43 to 264.58). The -7.1% day was 9/14 and the low close was $254.71 on 9/18, so the stock has already bounced ~4% and there is no fresh crash to fade; I drop my reversal tilt. Nothing company-specific is scheduled inside the window: Q3 results have come in early November in prior years and no date is set; PJM backstop (RBP) bids close Oct 21 but results come Dec 2, and the 2029/30 BRA is in December. Macro in window: the Oct 27-28 FOMC with the 10y at 5.24% after a September hike; a hawkish outcome is a modest negative for a long-duration power name. Residual Calpine-holder selling (~12-13M shares released in June 2026 still with holders) can add supply. Net: symmetric lognormal centred at spot ($264.6), monthly sigma ~13% (47%/3.5), with a hair more left-tail mass for rates/supply.

inputs_detail.derivation: Geometric interpolation between 2027 base mid $7.65 and 2029 base mid $11.65.

Framework implies ~$5.2 (2027 enhanced ~$5.0 after the Q2 raise, 2029 ~$5.6 at 32.5% of ~$17.3 total). I haircut ~10% because enhanced earnings depend on forward power prices/spark spreads and PJM capacity is collared at ~$325/MW-day through 2029/30 (10-Q), so they are the part most exposed to policy and price mean-reversion.

Round 1 used 19x. The 10y is now 5.24% (FRED), ~75bp above June, which compresses long-duration multiples; Citi's Neutral $297 target and ~$349 mean target imply 21-25x on lower rates. 18.5x is a de-rating toward IPP multiples while keeping a premium for ~18.5-year-duration nuclear contracts.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: NTM FCFbG at horizon ~$5.5B / ~350M diluted shares = ~$15.7/share at a 6.5% required yield

inputs_detail.input: NTM FCFbG at horizon (Q4-2027 to Q3-2028)
inputs_detail.derivation: Interpolate between ~$4.2B/yr (2026-27) and ~$6.1B/yr (2028-29), weighted to 2028, then haircut ~5% for enhanced/power-price exposure.
Less ~10M from the ~$2.8B remaining buyback at ~$270; the June-2027 Calpine unlock is existing shares, so it adds supply, not dilution.

Round 1 used 6% on a lower-rate assumption. With the 10y at 5.24% and BBB+/Baa1 power-company debt likely yielding ~6.3-6.6%, an equity FCF yield of 6.5% is the minimum consistent with my own credit-spread logic (FCFbG is pre-growth capex, so not all of it is distributable).

bear.story: Policy caps the scarcity rent (collar kept at the December 2026 2029/30 BRA, RBP adds cheap new-build supply), hyperscaler contracting stays slow, and the February 2027 guide lands at the framework (~$12-12.8) rather than the $13.3 consensus. Enhanced earnings shrink with forwards; 2028E ~$12.5 at ~14.5x. The ~25M-share Calpine unlock on 2027-06-30 and a 10y above 5% add pressure into the horizon.

base.story: Framework delivered (2026 ~$12, 2027 ~$12.5-13, 2028E ~$14), a few more premium nuclear contracts, Crane on track; multiple ~19x on 2028E with rates range-bound near 5%. Unlock supply absorbed by buybacks; stock roughly flat to slightly up.

bull.story: GW-scale hyperscaler deals once PJM co-location/large-load rules settle, Crane online 2027, power prices hold, enhanced earnings beat; 2028E ~$15.5 and multiple back to ~25x as yields ease.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$195 (~14x my 2028E of $14.1, ~15% under the 2026 low of $228.63) the market would be pricing an earnings-path break rather than supply or rate noise: a February 2027 guide well below the base/enhanced framework, adverse FERC/PJM co-location or collar rules that strand the 147M MWh open nuclear position, a Crane slip toward 2031, or a credit event (loss of IG would require ~$3.4B collateral). The June 2027 unlock (~25M shares) plus a >5% 10y can plausibly push the stock to $210-220 without breaking the thesis, so I keep the break below that.

reasoning: Round 2 revisions after the supervisor's fact-checks, verified in primary filings. (1) Growth target: I had misread '>10% rolling' as the near-term path; the Q2 deck and March outlook guide 20%+ BASE EPS growth 2026-2029, with enhanced earnings 30-40% of total. Rebuilding 2028E from base (~$9.45) plus enhanced (~$5.2 framework, haircut 10% to ~$4.65, since enhanced is the policy/price-exposed part) gives $14.10, close to my round-1 $14.00 but now derived correctly; note Q2 raised 2027 enhanced gross margin ~$250M, a small positive I had missed. (2) Supply: the June 2 8-K confirms half the Calpine consideration shares unlock 2027-06-30 (~25M) inside the horizon; my '5.9%' stake was unsourced and is dropped; this goes into the bear case. (3) Rates: FRED shows the 10y at 5.24% on 9/28, so I lift the FCF yield to 6.5% and trim the P/E to 18.5x. (4) Dates: the 2029/30 BRA is December 2026, not July 2027; the 9/29 move was +1.6%, not -7.1%, so my 1-month reversal tilt goes. Skeptic weighing unchanged otherwise: no accounting or credit red flags (BBB+/Baa1 stable), CEO sale in Feb 2026 is modest, litigation is noise; the downside is multiple compression, policy caps on scarcity rents and a possible guide below consensus, not distress. Fair value falls to ~$255 (P/E $261, FCF $242), about 4% below spot; I disagree with the supervisor's ~$272 mainly because I keep a haircut on enhanced earnings and use 18.5x rather than 19x at a 5.24% 10y. Scenarios $180/$270/$385 at 27/48/25 give a mean ~$275 (right skew). Ladder: lognormal median ~$263, sigma ~38% (below the 47% realized vol inflated by one-off policy/overhang shocks, above the 25-35% large-cap base rate) with a slightly fatter left tail for the unlock and a guide reset; P(>= spot) ~0.495. Research in round 2 limited to four primary fetches (8-K lock-up, Q2 slides, March outlook, FRED).
